fit_reason: Whole classic car (1966 Mustang coupe) listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Paint on hood, doors and quarters looks glossy with clear reflections in the outdoor shots
Chrome bumpers and stainless trim look bright in the front and rear photos

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1966 Mustang. The midnight purple paint and chrome already look sharp in your photos. If you want a final gloss enhancement buff before showings, we come to you and can do it on site. Would you like a quote?
